title: Product Roadmap Discussion
raw_text:
Lina: We need to talk about what comes after the dashboard. Sales is pushing for a notification system. Customer support wants better search. And we still have technical debt from the migration.

Sarah: All three are important. What does the team think?

Youssef: The search improvement is probably the easiest win. I could prototype something in a week.

Karim: The technical debt worries me more. We have raw SQL queries that are not using the ORM. If we keep building on top of this, it gets worse.

Lina: Sales says notifications are the top revenue driver. Two enterprise clients are waiting for it.

Sarah: Let us do notifications and search in parallel. Technical debt can wait until Sprint 15.

Karim: Who is doing what?

Sarah: We will sort out assignments at the next sprint planning. For now, just know the priorities are notifications first, search second, tech debt third.

Lina: Should I start writing requirements for both?

Sarah: Yes, start with notifications. Get the requirements to the team by next Monday.

Youssef: What about the search? Should I start the prototype now or wait?

Sarah: Wait for the sprint planning. Let us not get ahead of ourselves.

Sarah: Anything else? No? Meeting closed.
